name: Article 4, § 1 – 7
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation (AGILE)
part_text: 1. No additional appropriations from the general budget of the Union shall be committed under this Regulation for the development, production, testing, marketing or procurement of defence products or technologies that may contribute to further loss of life and undermine efforts to bring about a peaceful resolution of the conflict in Ukraine.
